name: Aktor Societe Anonyme Holding Company Technical and Energy Projects
summary: Aktor Societe Anonyme Holding Company Technical and Energy Projects engages in the construction business in Greece, European countries, and internationally. The company serves construction, renewable energy sources, real estate, participations, and facility management sectors. The company was formerly known as Intrakat Société Anonyme Technical and Energy Projects and changed its name to Aktor Societe Anonyme Holding Company Technical and Energy Projects in December 2024. Aktor Societe Anonyme Holding Company Technical and Energy Projects was founded in 1987 and is based in Paiania, Greece.
